assign.request: THE MAGAZINE: one composed experience at public/imagine/mag/ that uses everything today's column program proved - cover, contents, five-six real articles, a data piece with one filter, and a deliberate tone step per depth. Compose from the proven vocabulary; do not invent.
assign.now: reading the proven vocabulary - findings.md, columns.md, screens, feeds/data, vary/tone
steps: Read the vocabulary (findings, columns, screens, feeds, tone)
Write issue.json - 6 articles, real prose, one data set
Contents - index column, previews as nav
Article pages - reading column, bleed pull-quotes, next hop
Data piece - one fetch, one filter, live numbers

assign.now: built cover + contents + Article/Data + mag.css + issue.json; verifying headless

log.msg: shape: cover (full) > contents (large + index:true) > article (default track, the 40em measure). Every url cold-loads into the identical row.
cover is ONE page in three CSS states - full alone, 0 1 38.2% with the contents open, 0 1 20% once an article is open. Two :has() rules, no second render.

measured 1280/1920/3440 reading state: 256/512/512, 384/896/640, 688/1152/720. The golden share held at every depth left the article 370px at 1280 (46 characters) - that is why the third state exists.
tone ladder measured light+dark: cover ink 9% > contents ink 3.5% > article --surface. Opaque all three, or the row's empty-slot hairlines paint through.
data piece filter, all five chips: All 28 of 28 widest 3166px; 400 -> 7, widest 400; 1280 -> 7, widest 1051; 1920 -> 7, widest 1677; 3440 -> 7, widest 3166.

VERIFIED headless: 8 urls x 4 widths (400/1280/1920/3440) all 200, zero console errors, no horizontal overflow in any column. Click path cover>contents>article>next>next>jump all correct. Seam drag on the cover 384 -> 504, the move exactly.

bit: a subclass class-field runs AFTER super() (where Page assigns), so no = "" erased the entry number - defaults moved to initialize(). And the theme sizes h1/h2 at (0,2,0), so the headline scale is written at (0,3,0).

assign.outcome:
**The Magazine landed — Issue 01, *The Column*, six real articles you can read.** [Open it](/imagine/mag/) · [Contents](/imagine/mag/contents/) · [the data piece](/imagine/mag/contents/by-the-numbers/) · [readme](/imagine/mag/readme/) · [decisions](/imagine/mag/doc/decisions.md)

![](contents-1920.png)

Nothing in it is a new mechanism. Three columns of `/imagine/`'s own row, composed out of the seven labs' vocabulary:

| | url | word | tone |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cover | `/imagine/mag/` | `full`, then `0 1 38.2%`, then `0 1 20%` | ink 9% |
| Contents | `/contents/` | `large` + `index: true` | ink 3.5% |
| Article | `/contents/<slug>/` | none — the 40em measure | `--surface` |

**The cover is one page in three CSS states** — the screen, then the minor share of the golden pair, then a fifth of the row once you are reading. Two `:has()` rules, no second render, no state.

**Every word is one `issue.json`**, fetched once with a top-level `await` so the six articles are *declared* children and every article url cold-loads.

**The filter, all five chips:** All 28 of 28 · widest 3166px; 400 → 7 · 400px; 1280 → 7 · 1051px; 1920 → 7 · 1677px; 3440 → 7 · 3166px.

**Verified headless** — 8 urls x 400/1280/1920/3440, all 200, zero console errors, no horizontal overflow. Click path cover → contents → article → next → next → jump correct at every hop; the seam drag moves the cover 384 → 504, the move exactly. Reading widths 256/512/512 · 384/896/640 · 688/1152/720. Light and dark: [article](article-1920.png) · [dark](article-1920-dark.png) · [400](article-400.png) · [3440](reading-3440.png) · [data](data-1920.png) · [cover](cover-1920.png)
